facts.text: I'm the biggest cat in the Americas!
I live from Mexico all the way to Argentina.
My spots turn into rosettes, like little flowers, on my sides.
Unlike lots of cats, I'm a great swimmer!
I sneak up quietly, then pounce on my prey.
I hunt capybaras, deer, turtles and even fish!
My name may mean 'beast that catches prey in one leap'.
Belize made the world's first park just for jaguars!

cards: I bite so hard I can crack a turtle's shell!
Some jaguars are black, but their spots still show!

toys.caption: My shoulders come up to about your tummy!
